change: Full router + Wi-Fi Repeater + Multi-SSID RAM-boot release consolidating all 4-agent audit findings into one build: (1) rtl8192cd driver: enable CLIENT_MODE + UNIVERSAL_REPEATER (wlanX-vxd) + VXD_DIFF_MAC + MBSSID (wlanX-va0) with distinct MACs and skip site_survey on AP VAPs, fix 8814B/8197G ADDRCAM/StopMBSSID88XX_V2/StopHW88XX/STA BCNQ/NAPI-close races, harden RTK_BR_EXT NAT2.5 (br_port_exists, dynamic br_mac, skb_cloned expand, tailroom guard), and fix WEXT scan/stats/security IE/bounds (async rtl_siwscan, -EAGAIN + bss_backup + dBm + SIOCGIWENCODE in rtl_giwscan, WLAN_HDR_A3_LEN in rtw_get_sec_ie, WholeFrame clamp, rtl8192cd_get_wireless_stats, STA rtl_giwap/rtl_giwrate, rewrite_line clamp); (2) libiwinfo WEXT compat patch (patches/iwinfo-wext-rsd0614.patch): resolve radioN->wlanN, add .htmode/.survey/.lookup_phy stubs preventing rpcd SIGSEGV, parse /proc/<ifname>/sta_info for LuCI Associated Stations & /proc/<ifname>/mib_auth for Encryption, parse SIOCGIWNAME for hwmodelist/htmodelist, respect IW_QUAL_*_INVALID, and defer country to UCI; (3) netifd rtl8192cd.sh: full AP, STA (routed WISP / relayd / auto-NAT2.5 bridged), Same-Band Universal Repeater (wlanX + wlanX-vxd), and Multi-SSID Guest Wi-Fi (wlanX-va0) with bssid2join, per-VIF macaddr, control-char guard, and ordered down/up rollback; (4) LuCI wireless.js: fix upstream 19.07 Join Network .filter() truthy-array bug forcing encryption=sae on WPA2, re-enable Client mode, bind bssid/maxassoc/nat25_disable, and keep auto channel; (5) add relayd + luci-proto-relay + iwinfo CLI + zero-risk kernel diet (~260-350 KiB reclaimed) + rtl819x-eth.c eth_skb_pad() runt TX OOB DMA fix; all 6 MTDs stay read-only, pcie1/LEDs disabled, persistent flash NO-GO
